fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/CategoryPages/CategoryListingFuelType.cy.js#CategoryPages - CategoryListing [hydrogen] [en] — Hydrogen Trucks TC-CL-04: Call Now assistance lead submits successfully on Hydrogen Trucks
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-CL-04
**Title:** Call Now assistance lead submits successfully on Hydrogen Trucks
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Open the Hydrogen Trucks page, click the "Still confused?" widget's Call Now button to open the assistance lead form, fill model, name, mobile and city, and submit.

**Expected Result:**
The assistance form closes after a successful submission.

**Steps:**
1. Open the Hydrogen Trucks page
2. Click Call Now to open the assistance lead form
3. Fill model, name, mobile and city
4. Submit and verify the assistance form closes
